original_question:
Write the Verilog code for a module named `decoder_3to8`.
This module has a 3-bit input `in` ([2:0]) and an 8-bit output `out` ([7:0]).
Implement the logic such that `out` acts as an active-low 3-to-8 decoder. Specifically, when the value represented by the input `in` is `N` (where N is an integer between 0 and 7), the N-th bit of the output (`out[N]`) should be driven low (0), while all other bits of `out` should be driven high (1).
Consider including a default behavior for any unhandled input values (such as driving all outputs high).
